original_runtime: v0.5.18 plus supplied 29 patches and delivered 0042/0043/0044
scope: Only existing implemented functionality; roadmap proposals excluded.

patches.feature: Opt-in PD decode cache report and default streaming usage
patches.adaptation: environ.py and pd_disaggregation_hook.py; default false.

patches.feature: Trim speculative reasoning usage to emitted tokens
patches.adaptation: Finish-state update precedes speculative reasoning count and counts emitted tokens only; release test accepts 6 draft tokens but emits 2 and reports reasoning=2.

patches.feature: Tolerate unescaped control characters in history tool arguments
patches.adaptation: orjson fast path, json.loads(strict=False) fallback; object shape validation retained.

patches.feature: Strip leading UTF-8 BOM from JSON requests
patches.adaptation: Split ASGI chunks supported; non-JSON and non-leading BOM preserved.

patches.feature: Preserve HTTP status for abort before first SSE chunk
patches.adaptation: Chat and Completions first-result prefetch raises typed abort; after-stream errors remain SSE.

patches.feature: Report cached_tokens=0 when cache report enabled
patches.adaptation: UsageProcessor.calculate_response_usage and calculate_streaming_usage instantiate PromptTokensDetails without positive-count gate.

patches.feature: Chat builtin web_search compatibility
patches.adaptation: BuiltinWebSearchTool protocol, wrapper filtering, native browser adapter and Chat route delegation. Native Kimi request encoding filters builtin tools while retaining ordinary function fields.

patches.feature: Keep Chat IDs, errors and tool choice for builtin web search
patches.adaptation: Use actual OpenAIServingChat instance; release Responses constructor remains backwards compatible through optional lazy handler.

patches.feature: Mooncake PD bootstrap stage diagnostics
patches.adaptation: Manual adaptation to release DP-rank query prefetch, combined admission budget and _send_kv_metadata; preserves extended wire format.

patches.feature: Blacklist sessions after consecutive KV transfer failures
patches.adaptation: Default threshold 2, success resets sequence, state-send failure behavior and deferred abort poisoning preserved.

patches.feature: Mooncake background-thread liveness and progress metrics
patches.adaptation: Monitor wrappers retain returned threads and upstream role-switch _worker_threads stop/join lifecycle; Common heartbeat hook returns thread.

patches.feature: Local bootstrap metadata reference during cleanup
patches.adaptation: TransferInfo parsing keeps room_transfer_infos local after global entry removal; regression injects deletion during replica resolution.

patches.feature: Keep device prefix contiguous across host-only ancestors
patches.adaptation: Ported the device-prefix contiguity guard to the release Python UnifiedTreeCore; resident descendants beyond a host-only gap never extend the device prefix, including split matches. Old HiRadixCache is not recreated. The deployment profile must explicitly set SGLANG_UNIFIED_RADIX_TREE_CORE_BACKEND=python; the upstream Rust default/extension is unchanged.

patches.feature: Scheduler subprocess liveness metrics
patches.adaptation: Adapted to release parent-prelaunch process ownership and controller exclusion.

patches.feature: FPM decode metrics fallback when seq_lens_cpu absent
patches.adaptation: The release _decode_total_seq_lens helper already handles None, but the actual _build_scheduled_request_metrics builder did not. Its decode path now falls back to request.seqlen, with a direct regression.

patches.feature: Map known context-length errors to HTTP 413
patches.adaptation: Preserved error message matching and streaming error code behavior.

patches.feature: Exact prefetch capacity and FIFO retry
patches.adaptation: Default-off exact requested-plus-occupied capacity gate and strict FIFO migrated onto CacheRequestHandle-owned pending state. Oversize requests recompute instead of remaining pending; abort/reset/detach release waiters. Capacity retries do not consume the release storage re-query attempt budget, and prefetch_from_storage retains the release Optional[bool] PP-ticket return contract. Buffer-only mode retains official pool-backed allocation/FIFO behavior.

patches.feature: Hierarchical cache request/operation/transfer metrics
patches.adaptation: Request/operation/transfer observations, sampled normal summaries, rate-limited anomaly summaries and slow backup snapshots are attached to the release lifecycle. Admission observations describe committed admission, terminal observations are one-shot, and ACK-owned host/sidecar release remains with the official release owner. Cost/deadline sticky wait state survives zero-use metric discard until actual admission/abort.

patches.feature: Mooncake SDK batch object/byte/duration metrics
patches.adaptation: Mooncake lowest-level SDK wrappers preserve scalar/multi-buffer signatures, replication group config, result identity and exceptions. Count all calls, objects, durations and SDK-success bytes; these are not measured wire bytes. Independent review found no duplicate SDK accounting or ownership changes.

patches.feature: Cache prefix drift and host mutation attribution
patches.adaptation: Enqueue/admission/use drift and bounded node mutation history migrated to Python UnifiedTreeCore, including host allocation caller/free/budget/trigger attribution. History is bounded and reset-aware; failed admission does not overwrite a committed match. Full node attribution requires the explicit Python TreeCore deployment profile.

patches.feature: Bounded L3 recheck after local device prefix loss
patches.adaptation: Retain release _prefetch_after_device_hit_loss and StoragePrefetchRetries/max_attempts, without adding duplicate old retry machinery; restore record_l3_admission_recheck on the actual bounded retry path.

patches.feature: Throttled Prefill no-batch and FIFO diagnostics
patches.adaptation: Read-only rank-zero Prefill no-batch/FIFO snapshot after a sustained 2-second stall, with a 10-second log interval; capacity-event and node-history storage are bounded.

patches.feature: Retry pending FIFO head in Bootstrap queue
patches.adaptation: Retry only the oldest capacity waiter while it is still in the bootstrap queue, after official HiCache event processing. Preserve bootstrap order and official request-handle/ticket semantics; feature-off is a no-op.

patches.feature: Stable Chat streaming created timestamp
patches.adaptation: Release captures created once per _generate_chat_stream and passes to text/reasoning/tool/tail/usage paths.

patches.feature: Tool stream metadata only on initial delta
patches.adaptation: Only tool deltas use exclude_unset; ordinary Chat/nonstreaming defaults retained; explicit chunk object/created retained.

patches.feature: Account for PD handoff reasoning token without replay duplication
patches.adaptation: DecodeTransferQueue already calls _maybe_update_reasoning_tokens only when not replayed_boundary.

patches.feature: Protect speculative context execution window
patches.adaptation: Retain release allocator max_new_tokens_for_memory clipping while reserving one or two speculative windows.

patches.feature: DP admission, L3 cost aware and Prefill time budget
patches.adaptation: Migrate original feature implementation onto release APIs; do not apply old v0.5.18 combined backport verbatim.
patches.cache_prefill_adaptation: L3 cost-aware and Prefill time-budget portions retain release ownership, memory-budget and PP-ticket APIs; cache migration regressions pass. DP portion remains accounted by root.

patches.feature: v0.5.18 Req.kv compatibility fix
patches.adaptation: 0.5.22 has typed ownership; preserve full KV/Mamba/backup ownership checks in migrated admission rather than old None-only compatibility path.

patches.feature: Publish admission capacity after physical release
patches.adaptation: Equivalent feature commit 67dddaff migrated; test release result/free-group ordering.

patches.feature: Committed Prefill time-budget diagnostics
patches.adaptation: Migrate the existing Prefill time budget/model and committed diagnostics onto release PrefillAdder memory-budget and chunk alignment APIs. Removed unrelated newer-upstream Mamba-grid/replay dependencies from the three-way conflict; release accounting remains intact.

patches.feature: L3 lifecycle and terminal cost-decision diagnostics
patches.adaptation: Migrate existing L3 terminal cost diagnostics and sticky timeout/cost wait behavior onto release stage/insert/ACK ownership. A single first rank-agreed stop owns the outcome counter; legacy request/operation/SDK observation does not duplicate it. Two-rank Gloo deadline and cost agreement regressions pass.

legacy_api_and_mooncake.scope: Original Chat/Completion/Responses/protocol/usage suites plus new legacy API/BOM/Mooncake contracts and release batching/deferred-KV tests.

final_native_tools_followup.scope: One additional native-Kimi builtin filtering regression plus existing Kimi and legacy API contracts; the final total API/Mooncake collection contains 334 tests.

validation.static: All migrated API/Mooncake source/test files pass configured Ruff, format, isort and compilation checks; migration reject/backup files removed.
validation.parent_dp_admission: Final integration: 147 tests and 704 subtests passed, including real controller construction, HTTP/IPC, ownership and actual process liveness.
validation.cache_integration: Complete: 292 tests and 287 subtests passed, 2 CUDA-only tests skipped; includes real local two-rank Gloo lifecycle agreement.
validation.scope_limit: CPU contracts and mocked transport tests only; no GPU execution, Mooncake cluster load test or throughput validation performed by this audit.
validation.deployment_profile: Generated workers and startup preflight explicitly require SGLANG_UNIFIED_RADIX_TREE_CORE_BACKEND=python so Python tree fixes execute; upstream global default remains unchanged.

upstream_evidence.0008: python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/openai/usage_processor.py: UsageProcessor.calculate_response_usage and calculate_streaming_usage construct PromptTokensDetails even when cached_tokens is zero.
upstream_evidence.0033: python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/openai/serving_chat.py: _generate_chat_stream captures created once and propagates it across text, reasoning, tool, usage and final events.
upstream_evidence.0035: python/sglang/srt/disaggregation/decode.py: DecodeTransferQueue handoff runs _maybe_update_reasoning_tokens only if not replayed_boundary.

cache_prefill_release_v0522_cpu.skips: CUDA-required transfer stream ordering and direct backend device translation tests; no GPU hardware available.

suites.includes: Local two-rank Gloo agreement on deadline expiry and cost-aware stop; release cancellation/staging/ACK ownership.

cache_prefill_release_v0522_cpu.deployment_requirement: The full migrated Python cache behavior requires SGLANG_UNIFIED_RADIX_TREE_CORE_BACKEND=python in the generated P/D profile. The upstream global default and native Rust TreeCore binary remain unchanged.
cache_prefill_release_v0522_cpu.limitations: CPU tests verify logic, ordering and ownership; no new GPU throughput, latency or GLM numerical-accuracy claims.
